description:
About the Position

Utrecht University is hiring a postdoc on geodata science and GeoAI. The project develops machine-learning approaches for geospatial data, from spatiotemporal prediction to deep learning on earth-observation and sensor streams, with applications in environmental monitoring and spatial planning.

The postdoc will design and implement GeoAI methods, benchmark them against state-of-the-art baselines and apply them to concrete research questions together with domain partners. The position connects the university's geographical information science groups with its data-science community. The appointment is a salaried postdoctoral contract under the CAO-NU collective agreement.

Candidate Profile

Applicants hold a PhD in geoinformation science, computer science, remote sensing or a related field, with strong programming skills in Python and experience with geospatial machine learning frameworks. A publication record in relevant venues and experience handling large geospatial datasets are expected. The working language is English.

Highlights

  • GeoAI and spatiotemporal machine learning
  • Deep learning on earth-observation data
  • Environmental monitoring applications
  • Benchmarking and reproducible geospatial methods
  • Collaboration with domain and data-science partners
  • Salaried postdoc under the CAO-NU agreement

About Utrecht University

Utrecht University is a leading Dutch research university, consistently ranked among the top institutions in Europe. Its research and teaching span four faculties and a broad range of strategic themes, including sustainability, dynamics of youth, institutions for open societies and life sciences. PhD candidates and postdocs in the Netherlands are salaried staff members with full employment benefits under the CAO-NU collective agreement, so advertised positions are fully funded. Academic and support vacancies are published on the university's working-at portal, with clear deadlines and application instructions per position.
